rationale: Eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by extending high-margin (2.0x-3.5x) Town Shop contract fulfillment through Day 30 while strictly gating seed procurement by maturation horizons (halting Pumpkins at Day 23, Tomatoes at Day 25, and Carrots at Day 27) to prevent capital stranding. Replaces indiscriminate fire-selling with a two-tier liquidation hierarchy (requiring cyclical premium >= 1.05x base price and raising shed relief to 88% with an emergency discard floor only at >= 96%), eliminates the phantom 4-unit Wheat feed reserve when holding zero livestock, and caps land expansion at 20-22 contiguous plots with a safe $110 hiring buffer to reach 10 hands by Day 6-8 without midnight wage stress.
